```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
```

# Load Data
```{r data}
# CHANGE DATA PATHS BELOW
deacon_results <- read_csv("/Users/katelynnguyen/Downloads/host_filtration_benchmark/deacon_results/deacon_parameter_results.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    tool = "Deacon",
    param1 = as.character(a),
    param2 = r
  )

biobloom_results <- read_csv("/Users/katelynnguyen/Downloads/host_filtration_benchmark/biobloom_results/parameter_results.csv")
  # Replace binomial with b, harmonic with h
biobloom_results$S[biobloom_results$S == "binomial"] <- "b"
biobloom_results$S[biobloom_results$S == "harmonic"] <- "h"
biobloom_results <- biobloom_results %>%
  mutate(
    tool = "Biobloom",
    param1 = S,
    param2 = s
  )

cleanifier_results <- read_csv("/Users/katelynnguyen/Downloads/host_filtration_benchmark/cleanifier_results/parameter_results.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    tool = "Cleanifier",
    param1 = NA,
    param2 = threshold
  )

movi_results <- read_csv("/Users/katelynnguyen/Downloads/host_filtration_benchmark/movi2_benchmark.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    param1 = NA,
    param2 = NA
  )

srascrubber_results <- read_csv("/Users/katelynnguyen/Downloads/host_filtration_benchmark/srascrubber_benchmark.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    param1 = NA,
    param2 = NA
  ) %>%
  filter(dataset == "medium")

rype_results <- read_csv("/Users/katelynnguyen/Downloads/host_filtration_benchmark/rype_results/parameter_results.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    param1 = NA,
    param2 = NA
  )

bowtie_results <- read_csv("/Users/katelynnguyen/Downloads/host_filtration_benchmark/bowtie2_results/bowtie2_parameter_results.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    param1 = NA,
    param2 = NA
  )

combined_results <- bind_rows(deacon_results, biobloom_results, cleanifier_results, movi_results, srascrubber_results, rype_results)

# Calculate sensitivity, specificity
combined_results_unique <- combined_results %>% 
  mutate(
    sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn),  # Sensitivity formula (True Positive Rate)
    specificity = tn / (tn + fp)   # Specificity formula (True Negative Rate)
  )

combined_results_unique <- combined_results_unique %>%
  mutate(label = if_else(tool == "Cleanifier", 
                        as.character(param2),         # Only param2 for cleanifier
                        paste0("(", param1, ",", param2, ")"))) %>%
  mutate(memory_mb = memory / 1024)

# Convert FP, FN to FPR and FNR
combined_results_unique <- combined_results_unique %>% 
  mutate("FPR" = fp / 1000000, "FNR" = fn / 1000000)

combined_results_unique <- combined_results_unique %>%
  mutate(
    tool = case_when(
      tool == "Biobloom" & param1 == "h" ~ "Biobloom_h",
      tool == "Biobloom" & param1 == "b" ~ "Biobloom_b",
      TRUE ~ tool
    )
  )

# One label for parameters
# Best and worse labels
combined_results_unique <- combined_results_unique %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  arrange(desc(sensitivity), runtime, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    spec_rank = row_number(),
    label_sensitivity = case_when(
      spec_rank == 1 ~ label,        # best: highest sensitivity, fastest runtime tie-break
      spec_rank == n() ~ label,      # worst
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(fp, fn, .keep_all = TRUE) # Keep best runtime, remove duplicates
```
```{r}
# Plot minimum FP and FN
fp_fn_min_by_tool <- combined_results_unique %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  summarise(
    false_positives = min(fp, na.rm = TRUE),
    false_negatives = min(fn, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(false_positives, false_negatives),
    names_to = "error_type",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(error_type == "false_positives")

ggplot(fp_fn_min_by_tool, aes(x = tool, y = count, fill = 'red')) +
geom_col(position = "dodge") +
theme_minimal(base_size = 30) +
labs(
title = "False Positives",
color = "Tool"
) 

fp_fn_min_by_tool <- combined_results_unique %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  summarise(
    false_positives = min(fp, na.rm = TRUE),
    false_negatives = min(fn, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(false_positives, false_negatives),
    names_to = "error_type",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(error_type == "false_negatives")
```

# Plot FP vs FN
```{r fp_vs_fn_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
# Plot FP vs FN
parameters_unique <- combined_results_unique %>%
  group_by(tool) %>% 
  filter(tool %in% c("Biobloom_h", "Biobloom_b", "Deacon", "Cleanifier"))
ggplot(parameters_unique, aes(x = FPR, y = FNR, label = label, color = tool)) +
geom_point(aes(color = tool), size = 3) +
# geom_text_repel(
#   vjust = -1.6,
#   size = 4,
#   segment.color = NA,
#   show.legend = FALSE,
#   max.overlaps = 1e6   # increase limit
# ) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
labs(
title = "False Positives vs False Negatives",
x = "False Positive Rate (FPR)",
y = "False Negative Rate (FNR)",
color = "Tool"
) +
theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), plot.margin = margin(20, 40, 20, 40)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
```
# Plot senstivity, specificity separately
```{r}
ggplot(combined_results_unique, aes(x = tool, y = sensitivity, label = label_sensitivity, color = tool)) +
geom_point(aes(color = tool), size = 3) +
scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.99, 1.0)) +
geom_text_repel(
  vjust = -1.6,
  size = 4,
  segment.color = NA,
  show.legend = FALSE,
  max.overlaps = 1e6   # increase limit
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
labs(
title = "Sensitivity",
x = "Tool",
y = "Sensitivity",
color = "Tool"
) +
theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), plot.margin = margin(20, 40, 20, 40)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
```

```{r}
best_sensitivity <- combined_results_unique %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  filter(sensitivity == max(sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%   # in case of ties
  ungroup()
ggplot(best_sensitivity, aes(x = tool, y = sensitivity, fill = factor(tool))) +
# geom_point(aes(color = tool), size = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.8, 1.0)) +
  geom_col() +
theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
labs(
title = "Sensitivity",
x = "Tool",
y = "Sensitivity",
fill = "Tool"
) +
 theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", "\n"))
```

# Plot Runtime
```{r}
best_runtime <- combined_results_unique %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  filter(runtime == max(runtime, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%   # in case of ties
  ungroup()
ggplot(best_runtime, aes(x = tool, y = runtime, fill = factor(tool))) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Runtime for Each Tool",
    x = "Tool",
    y = "Runtime (s)",
    fill = "Tool"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", "\n"))
```

# Runtime of One Tool Across Parameters
```{r plot2}
ggplot(deacon_results, aes(x = r, y = runtime, color = factor(r))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Runtime vs r (Grouped by a)",
    x = "r parameter",
    y = "Runtime (s)",
    color = "r value"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
# Memory
```{r memory}
ggplot(combined_results_unique, aes(x = tool, y = memory_mb, fill = factor(tool))) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Memory for Each Tool",
    x = "Tool",
    y = "Maximum RSS (MB)",
    fill = "Tool"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
```
